basic_details.short_information: Central Silk Board (CSB) has announced 5 vacancies for the Sericulture Assistant post on a purely contractual basis for an initial period of one year, with postings at Berhampore, Shillong, and Mangaldoi. Candidates applying for the post require prescribed qualifications in Sericulture, Agriculture Sciences, Forestry, Biological Sciences, or Biotechnology, as applicable, including the required postgraduate diploma or relevant work experience where specified, alongside an upper age limit of 35 years as of November 6, 2026. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Sericulture Assistant post distributed across specific regional centres and institutes under the Central Silk Board.

rows.unit_location: Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute (CSB-CSRTI), Berhampore

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Sericulture Assistant position must meet the prescribed educational and professional qualifications. Experience in silkworm rearing and grainage in the pre-cocoon sector is desirable.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Prescribed qualifications in Sericulture, Agriculture Sciences, Forestry, Biological Sciences or Biotechnology, as applicable, including the required postgraduate diploma or relevant work experience where specified.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹21,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). The engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of one year at its Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute (CSB-CSRTI), Berhampore, West Bengal, and its associated units. This engagement does not confer any right to regularisation, absorption, or permanent appointment in the Central Silk Board.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSB Sericulture Assistant
content_sections.text: Visit the official hiring portal at https://csb-hiring.in/. Prepare self-attested copies of documents supporting your eligibility. Apply online through https://csb-hiring.in/, along with self-attested copies of documents supporting your eligibility. Submit the application online on or before November 6, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based solely on performance in a personal interview. The date, time, and venue of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates through email. Candidates must produce their original certificates and valid identity proof for verification at the time of the interview. No travel allowance, daily allowance, or expenses for lodging and boarding will be provided.
